ruling: Item 37 rulings draft, section 16, item 25 (the owner, 19 November 2026: "All accepted"): "The SCN7A edge is removed for all 26 drugs that carry it, not only the four examined: it is an artefact of the ChEMBL_37 family target CHEMBL2331043"
sources: ChEMBL_37 target CHEMBL2331043 "Sodium channel alpha subunit", PROTEIN FAMILY, ten members with SCN7A among them (data/raw/chembl/targets.json; its target record lists SCN7A as a GROUP MEMBER); ChEMBL_37 single-protein target CHEMBL3585 (Nax), which UniProt Q01118 cross-references and which carries none of these mechanisms; the Fable pass of 19 November 2026 (scn7a_check_2026-11-19.md in that session's scratchpad), which found no source showing any of the drugs acting on Nax (phenytoin: no strong block at 300 uM)
note: SCN7A (Nax) leaves the family for every drug; the family's magnitude is spread over the nine voltage-gated members that are graph nodes. PROTEIN:SCN7A catalyses MAR_SODIUM_LEAK beside NALCN, so these edges were acting on the sodium leak. The family rows themselves are to become one class-level annotation at reduced weight (R4, P5, P8), whose weight waits on sourcing; this row removes only the member no source supports
